items.source: Methods implemented here follow a specific naming pattern "lowercase type name + bridged method name", so that the agent can consistently rewrite calls to instrumented methods. For example Class#forName(String) will be here names classforName(String).
items.translation: 此处实现的方法遵循特定的命名模式“小写类型名 + 桥接方法名”，以便代理能够一致地重写对已增强方法的调用。例如，`Class#forName(String)` 在此处将命名为 `classforName(String)`。

items.source:
This class should only be used by the runtime-hints agent when instrumenting bytecode
and is not considered public API.
items.translation: 该类仅应在运行时提示代理对字节码进行插桩时使用，不被视为公共 API。
